goldPairApprovals.note: User confirmed all 30 proposed pairs match artwork (CP6->xy12 added after the 20th Anniversary crawl). XY11A->xy11 approved on 2026-09-19: the XY11a category was wrong (it held the SWSH S2a set), so XY11a had no records; it now crawls Category:Fever-Burst Fighter cards and pairs with Steam Siege. BREAK->g1 approved the same day: the BREAK Starter Pack deck (no printed set code) pairs 65 printings with Generations; its 11 Trainer reprints stay out because their English printings are in unsupported eras. 2026-09-23: 31 marketplace-only records were added for English cards whose Japanese printing has a set but no card number (XY Black Star Promos -> XY-P Promotional cards, the Generations basic energies, and Evolutions 92/108). No exact record changed, so the artwork approvals still apply. The runtime fails closed on such a record instead of letting TCGdex guess a printing from another era (see AGENTS.md).

randomSampleReview.note: All samples matched live TCGdex after the page-title name fix (Mega/Primal/BREAK prefixes). Re-run on 2026-09-19 after the XY11a category fix: 60 checked, 0 flagged, including the new XY11A->xy11 pairs.

fullValidationReview.note: Full pass with scripts/bulbapedia/sample-review.mjs xy --all (seed 20260301, live TCGdex). Eight flags were a transient TCGdex 503 and cleared on a re-run. The rest are artifacts, not wrong pairings: TCGdex appends the Team Flare Gear subtitle to Phantom Forces 92/102/106 ("Target Whistle Team Flare Gear"), and its EN record for Evolutions 109 still carries the Japanese name (ナッシー[Exeggutor]). Card number, set and HP match in every case.
